simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֵחִי (H278) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֵחִי (ʼÊchîy) means Echi , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Gen 46 21.

definitions.full: H278. Echi אֵחִי proper name, masculine a son of Benjamin Gen 46:21 (P) (perhaps corruption of אֲחִירָם Num 26:38 (P); so also אַחֲרַח 1Chr 8:1 compare אַחֵר 7:12 & comm.) אחל (existence & meaning dubious)
